terra.problem: The dead man coming out is a fact from outside this passage, but the explanation does not reference John 11:44.
“Many believed first” adds a sequence between believing and reporting to the Pharisees that the text does not give.
The explanation says the signs are right in front of the council, but the passage does not say the council witnessed them.
The claim that Sabbath trouble comes up elsewhere needs a reference to a passage outside this one.
Calling the signs the council’s “whole worry” overlooks their stated concern that the Romans will come and take away their place and nation.
The claim about Roman rule is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a supporting reference.
